meta.title: DeepSeek Chat
meta.description: Left-sidebar entry and right-Sidebar panel for chat.deepseek.com, with user settings to choose where it shows (at least one stays visible). Desktop (Windows/macOS/Linux): embedded webview with the session restored across restarts. Web GUI: the site forbids iframes, so a one-click external open is offered. Uses the chat web app's free basic service, so everyday chats cost no API quota.
